name: Noise/variance calibration
research_question: How noisy are repeated identical Spark runs on this machine?

name: Configuration sensitivity grid (SC1 gate)
research_question: Does the chosen action space move execution time >=10% on >=2 workload families?

name: Static baseline calibration
research_question: What are the best static configurations per workload family (validation split only)?

name: RL training (tabular Q, cached, offline-init)
research_question: Can the agent converge within <=500 Spark executions?

name: Main comparison vs 6 baselines
research_question: Does RL beat default/static/heuristic/random-search on the frozen test set?

name: Generalization study
research_question: Does the frozen policy retain its advantage on unseen scale/family/seeds?

name: State ablations A1/A2
research_question: Does runtime feedback in the state help?

name: Reward/action/gamma ablations A3/A4/A5
research_question: How do reward and action-space design affect the learned policy?

name: Monitoring overhead
research_question: Is adaptation-loop overhead <=5% of job time?

name: Public-dataset external validity
research_question: Does the policy transfer to NYC Taxi data?

name: Reproducibility re-run
research_question: Do fresh re-runs agree within +/-5% median?

name: Demo run-book
research_question: Is the demo deterministic and under 10 minutes?
